problem.title: Removing Minimum and Maximum From Array

approaches.title: Scan for extrema and compare deletion options
approaches.summary: Find the minimum and maximum values and their indices in one pass, then evaluate removing from the left, right, or both ends. Return the smallest deletion count.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Implemented a one-pass scan using sentinel initial values to locate the minimum and maximum indices, then computed the three deletion strategies.
Initialized extrema from the first element and used an `else if` for the scan, making the same approach more idiomatic without changing its strategy.
